{{Top}}
'''Kerdos Company''' was a recycling company that owned a number of garbage recycling plants all over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] chased the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] through one such [[Kerdos Company recycling plant/Legends|recycling plant]] after Wesell made an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] life.
